name: Specific Numbers Guarantee
surface: Paid Search Landing Pages, Performance Tools
blueprintProse:
This formula combines precise performance integers, bounded time horizons, and complete risk reversals. The structural ratio divides into 40% for the exact performance metric, 25% for the timeframe, and 35% for the risk reversal. 
This pattern activates ambiguity aversion and the specificity heuristic. Humans subconsciously interpret rounded figures as approximations or promotional exaggerations. In contrast, irregular integers signal precise telemetry and verifiable data, reassuring risk-averse evaluators.
template: [Eradicate / Achieve Exact Metric Integer] Within [Precise Number of Days/Hours], or [Asymmetric Risk-Reversal Concession]

example.bland: We make your website load faster or your money back.
example.optimized: Cut your mobile checkout page render speed below 750ms in 14 days, or you pay nothing.
